candidate.user_submission: This child is 12 months old and has had cough or difficult breathing for 3 days. There has been no convulsing now or history of convulsions, and the child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child is able to drink or breastfeed and does not vomit everything. There is no diarrhoea, no ear problem, and no fever. The breaths were counted for one full minute while the child was calm, with a respiratory rate of 40 breaths per minute. There is no chest indrawing, no stridor when calm, and no wheezing. Recurrent wheeze is not present. A pulse oximeter is not available.
